result.title: Oriented Semi-DETR for Semi-Supervised Aerial Object Detection
result.summary: Semi-supervised object detection has recently been extended to DETR, where oriented boxes introduce an ambiguity that does not arise for axis-aligned boxes: the map from parameters to rectangles is two-to-one, since $(c_x,c_y,w,h,θ)$ and $(c_x,c_y,h,w,θ+π/2)$ denote the same rotated rectangle. Losses and matching costs are computed from the parameters, so two boxes that coincide in space can be far apart in the metric that drives training. A correctly localized student box is then penalized by the regression loss, and the inflated matching cost leads the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) filter to discard it. We propose Oriented Semi-DETR, which removes this ambiguity wherever a pseudo box enters training. Swap-aligned Target Selection regresses towards the encoding closer to the student prediction. A Swap-invariant Reliability Cost minimizes over the two encodings inside the matching cost, so the filter decides on geometry alone. Swap-aware Pseudo-label Denoising starts denoising earlier, ramps its loss weight linearly, and weights each query by the teacher score and encoding margin. All three are parameter-free and require no additional forward pass. Across all label ratios of DOTA-v2.0, Oriented Semi-DETR outperforms DETR-based supervised and semi-supervised baselines, with the largest gains at the strict IoU threshold.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对旋转框半监督 DETR 检测，指出旋转框参数到矩形的映射是二对一的，导致回归损失与匹配代价在参数空间中被错误放大。作者提出交换对齐的目标选择、交换不变的可靠性代价与交换感知的伪标签去噪三项无参数改动，在 DOTA-v2.0 各标签比例上优于 DETR 类基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 旋转框的冗余参数化引发「同一几何、不同编码」的度量失配，且由 GMM 滤波器据此丢弃正确样本，这与 latent 相似度中编码冗余、不变性度量及证据/伪标签筛选的问题可能相通，可供核查，但论文本身不做推理过程建模。
